# trino_roles Data Source

Lists the catalog roles in a Trino catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "trino_roles" "example" {
  catalog = "hive"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog` (String) Catalog whose roles should be listed.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (List of String) Roles in the catalog, sorted by name.
